fio.ajuda: Write in blocks and publish everything at once: the first one opens the conversation and the others follow, in order.
fio.limite: A thread has up to 10 blocks.
fio.vazio: One block is empty: write in it or remove it.
fio.semAgenda: A thread goes out right away. To schedule, publish a single block.
fio.esperando: The start of the thread is out. The other {n} blocks wait for moderation to read the block above and go out when it is released.
fio.desfeito: Thread undone. Your text is still here.

fuso.ajuda: The time counts in the time zone you choose. Alumia does not find out where you are.

link.doServidor: Title, summary and image fetched by our server.

erros.invalido_fio: A thread needs 2 to 10 blocks, all with text.
erros.invalido_figurinha: That sticker is not part of the house pack.
erros.invalido_legenda: A caption can be up to 280 characters.
erros.legenda_revisar: A caption has a word that goes to moderation for reading. Change the caption or remove it.
erros.invalido_fuso: Choose a time zone from the list.
erros.nivel_imagens: Your trust level does not yet allow that many images in one post.
